description: This file provides a helper function 'geocodeAddress' to perform geocoding by querying the Nominatim API from OpenStreetMap. It exports the function for use in other modules, converting a free-text address into latitude and longitude coordinates.

methods.name: geocodeAddress(address)
methods.description: Converts a free-text address into latitude and longitude using the Nominatim geocoding API. Validates input, performs fetch request, handles errors, and returns location data.
